beats.text: One day, Ravana's sister Surpanakha saw Rama and fell in love. She had a pot belly, copper-colored hair and long claws for nails.
She took a beautiful form and asked him to marry her. 'Leave this thin woman,' she said. 'I will eat her, and we will wander the forest together.'
Rama smiled and said, 'I am married. Ask my brother. He is alone here.'
Lakshmana laughed and refused too. 'I am only a servant. Go back to Rama. He will make you his second wife.'
She realized they were mocking her. Her beautiful form fell away, and her true face burned with rage.
Furious, she rushed at Sita in a rage.
Lakshmana stepped in to protect Sita and drove her away in disgrace.
Burning with hatred, she fled through the forest, howling, to her brothers.
